Blackpool is trying to sign 25-year-old Austrian defender Thomas Piermayr. He has been training with the club this week. Blackpool wants to sign him because they expect to be in League One next season. Piermayr is currently a free agent and last played for the Colorado Rapids. He previously played for Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 2011 and represented Austria’s Under-21 team. Although he has never played in England, Blackpool could give him his first opportunity.

Tony Pulis plans to speak with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace after the team secures its place in the Premier League. His goal is to help the club return to being a top-ten team. Pulis believes the club has lost its way in recent years and needs major changes to get back on track. Under previous managers Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke, West Brom finished 10th and 8th. However, last season was chaotic, and the team struggled to stay in the league, finishing 17th. The paragraph also notes that Tony Pulis, the current manager, was seen shouting instructions from the sideline during a match against Manchester City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott is leaving north London. Wright thinks Walcott’s difficult time at the club happened because Arsene Wenger refused to play him as a striker. Since returning from a serious knee injury, Walcott has started only five games this season after being out for seven months. With Arsenal trying to sign Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ending next summer, Wright is worried the team might lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez believes Ross Barkley will become an even more important player for both Everton and England now that he has overcome his difficult second season at Everton. Barkley has had a mixed season for the team, partly because he was selected for England’s World Cup squad last summer and partly because a knee surgery delayed his return to playing. However, England coach Roy Hodgson still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez thinks Barkley’s two recent substitute appearances for England against Lithuania and Italy show that he is ready to improve his performance.

England will not play in the Under-19 European Championships this summer. They lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match. Before this game, England had beaten Denmark and Azerbaijan. To reach the finals in Greece in July, they needed to win against France in Saint-Lo. However, goals from Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet gave France the lead. A late goal by Patrick Roberts, who plays for Fulham, was not enough for England’s coach Sean O’Driscoll’s team to qualify.

Newcastle midfielder Jonas Gutierrez wants to help his team beat their rivals, Sunderland, in an important match. The 31-year-old player from Argentina has come back from testicular cancer and has played as a substitute in the last three games. His teammates and fans have welcomed him back warmly. However, Newcastle has lost all three of those games. Gutierrez really wants to stop this losing streak when Newcastle plays Sunderland on Sunday.

After a close game between South Sydney and Canterbury, angry fans threw plastic water bottles and insults at the referees and officials. The match ended in controversy when South Sydney won 18-17 in the final minute. This victory happened because the referee, Gerard Sutton, penalized Canterbury’s captain, James Graham, in the last moments of the game. The incident occurred at ANZ Stadium in Sydney on Good Friday. As the officials and players left the field, a group of spectators started throwing objects and shouting at them.

Kevin Sinfield, the former captain of the England rugby league team, has been warned that he will be a "target" when he switches to rugby union at the end of the season. The 34-year-old, who is considered the greatest captain in Leeds Rhinos' history, surprised the rugby league world on Tuesday by announcing he will leave the sport. He will join Yorkshire Carnegie, the sister club of Leeds Rhinos, on an 18-month contract.

Raheem Sterling has said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool, even though the club offered him £100,000 a week to stay. The 20-year-old winger is getting closer to leaving Anfield. In a BBC interview on Wednesday, he said that if he had been asked a year ago, he would have signed for much less money.

Even though Sterling is one of Liverpool’s best players, he has not played as well as he did last season. He has scored only six goals this season—one fewer than Stoke’s Jon Walters. His efficiency has also dropped, as shown in the graphic below.

Brighton and Hove Albion, a football team in the Championship league, is the first club to teach its young players about the laws and ethics of sexual consent. According to the BBC, the club is also providing counseling to these players.

The program, called Protect, Inform and Prevent (PIP), teaches players how to understand consent under the law. The training includes private question-and-answer sessions where players can discuss past experiences. The sessions are led by a former police detective and a psychotherapist.

A new video shows homeless people reading cruel tweets written about them. This video was made by Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans. It is meant to make people think more carefully about how they treat homeless people. Many of the people in the video cry as they read mean comments, such as "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you" and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited."

George Boyd is the hardest-working player in the Barclays Premier League this season. He has run a total of 210.5 miles on the field. This distance is the same as running from Burnley’s stadium, Turf Moor, to Crystal Palace’s stadium, Selhurst Park, in south London.

Boyd has run slightly farther than Christian Eriksen, a midfielder for Tottenham Hotspur. According to Google Maps, walking from Turf Moor to Selhurst Park would normally take 69 hours. However, Boyd has covered this distance in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby who was found dead. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, live in Perry Barr, Birmingham. They were taken into custody after their daughter died yesterday afternoon.

Police were called to the family’s home just before 1:00 am yesterday because the baby was having trouble breathing. The child was taken to Birmingham Children’s Hospital, but she died a few hours later.

A police spokesperson said the death is being treated as suspicious. A post-mortem examination will take place today to find out exactly what caused the baby’s death.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by pausing contract talks until the summer. The 20-year-old England player was offered a huge deal, believed to be £100,000 a week, but negotiations have stalled. Sterling says he is not just interested in money, and Taylor thinks it is smart to wait until the season ends before continuing discussions. Sterling also admitted in a TV interview that he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool yet.

Things have been difficult for Anderson, a former Manchester United player, since he returned to Brazil. However, on Wednesday, his mistakes were overshadowed by the foolish actions of a teammate.

Anderson was sent off from his team, Internacional, after shoving Ypiranga Erechim striker Otacilio Neto. This happened even though the ball was not in play. Neto was also sent off for hitting back with an elbow.

Fortunately for Anderson, his teammate Fabricio stole the attention by swearing at his own fans. Fabricio became the third player to be sent off, leaving Internacional with only nine players. The match ended in a 1-1 draw in Porto Alegre.

A seven-year-old boy was attacked by two young men while he was out buying food. The attackers took him to a secluded spot and raped him. When the boy fought back, they set him on fire.

The boy suffered burns over 30 percent of his body but managed to escape. Inspector Sasthe told PTI that the incident happened in Padma Nagar, a neighborhood in Bhiwandi, which is a suburb of Mumbai. Police are currently investigating the case.

Dug, a pug, has fully recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. On Thursday, Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, Canada. They heard a rattling noise. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the sound. The snake bit Dug in the face, causing his face to swell to twice its normal size.

Real Madrid defender Alvaro Arbeloa says that Jose Mourinho might manage Real Madrid again in the future, even though he left the club in a difficult way. Mourinho managed Real Madrid for three years before returning to Chelsea in 2013. When he left, there were rumors that he had arguments with top players, including captain Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. However, Arbeloa, who has played 25 times for the team this season, believes that Real Madrid would still consider hiring the Portuguese coach back as manager.

Liverpool’s hopes of reaching the Champions League ended at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday. Manager Brendan Rodgers admitted this during a 15-minute press conference, marking the end of their efforts. Although he tried to stay positive, he did not hide the fact that it has been a tough season. Last year, Liverpool fought hard for the title, but this year they have fallen out of the race. It is a disappointing result for a club that hoped to return to success. Despite this, it still seems like Liverpool are progressing under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry after his team tied 1-1 at home against the last-place team, Parma. Because of this result, Inter is now tied for ninth place, 10 points away from the spots that qualify for European competitions.

To address the players' attitude, Mancini cancelled their Easter day off and made them come to training early on Sunday morning. The team trained at 8:30 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio watched the session. Inter confirmed this on their website, www.inter.it.

Many fans want to buy rare items from their favorite players or teams, and small pieces of sports history can sell for thousands of pounds. However, an expired passport belonging to Paul Parker was listed on eBay for £5,000. Parker is well-known for playing as a right-back for Manchester United and England in the 1990s. The listing started in early March, and bidding ended on Tuesday, but it is not clear if anyone actually paid the high price.

A builder named Paddy Morrall saw an image of Jesus on a piece of wood in Inverness, Scotland, on Wednesday, just a few days before Easter. The image appeared on a broken scaffolding board after it was left out in the rain for several hours. The figure looks like a full-length Jesus wearing a robe.

People have seen similar images on toast, pancakes, crisps, and ice cream before. Paddy, a 31-year-old builder from Keighley near Bradford, was surprised by what he saw. He has kept the wooden board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly match. This game was between two countries that used to be part of Czechoslovakia.

Ondrej Duda, a 20-year-old midfielder, scored the only goal after halftime. He kicked a low shot from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute. This was his second goal for his national team.

This win was Slovakia’s third victory in 10 matches against the Czech Republic since the two countries split in 1993. The Czech Republic has won five of those games.

During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel hit Czech player Daniel Kolar in the face with a high kick. Slovakia celebrated their win, which continues their strong recent performance.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed he can do more than just play football. He posted a video of himself rapping while driving his Bugatti Veyron. The video was shared as Real Madrid gets ready to play Granada at the Bernabeu stadium on Sunday. In the clip, Benzema sings along to Tupac’s song "Check Out Time." Some might have thought Tupac’s song "All Eyez on Me" would have been a better fit for the player, who has scored 20 goals in all competitions this season. The video shows the Real Madrid and France forward singing along to Tupac in his car.

Harvey Boulter, a businessman who supports UKIP, is trying to stop a popular Conservative candidate from winning. Boulter previously helped force Liam Fox to quit as Defence Secretary. As part of his ongoing conflict with Fox, Boulter has already given £30,000 to the UKIP candidate running against Fox in Somerset. Now, Boulter is spending another £30,000 to try to defeat Tom Tugendhat, the Conservative candidate in Tonbridge and West Malling, Kent.

Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield played to a 1-1 draw in their Yorkshire derby. Two goals were scored in the final four minutes of the match. Sergiu Bus, a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored first in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute, tied the game for Huddersfield with a goal just before the end. This result means Huddersfield has not won any of their last seven games. They are currently 18th in the league table, six places and nine points behind Sheffield Wednesday.

Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton signed him three years ago. At that time, Dallas was playing part-time for Crusaders, a local team, for just £70 a week. Now, the 23-year-old has impressed for Northern Ireland and scored two great goals in Brentford’s 4-1 win over Fulham on Good Friday. Brentford is now aiming for promotion to the Premier League, not just a spot in the playoffs. They will play Nottingham Forest on Monday. Dallas has been a key player this season, helping Brentford move closer to reaching the top flight.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it is no surprise that fans feel strongly about their favorite professional teams. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals and the two most popular teams, with the Yankees ranking first and the Red Sox second in fan support. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves also have many fans, especially in the South. However, some teams, like the New York Mets, have fewer supporters. Scroll down for the video.

Trey Moses, a basketball player at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky, made a girl named Ellie Meredith very happy. Ellie has Down syndrome. On Thursday, Trey asked Ellie to be his date for the upcoming prom.

Trey is a senior who will play basketball for Ball State next year. He also volunteers with teenagers who have learning disabilities. He surprised Ellie during her P.E. class with flowers and a sign that said, "Let's Party Like it's 1989." This is a reference to a Taylor Swift album, because Taylor Swift is Ellie’s favorite singer.

Ellie said yes. She told CNN that she can’t wait to go dress shopping because she has already told "a million people" about the news.

On April Fools' Day, President Barack Obama pretended to be Frank Underwood, a character from the TV show *House of Cards*. Frank Underwood is played by actor Kevin Spacey and often talks to the audience in a Shakespearean style.

Obama said, "Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood... This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools' Day. Frank learned it from me." He also used a Southern accent to sound like the character.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday because of a possible heart problem. He was playing in a match against Fenerbahce but had to leave the game after just 30 minutes. Doctors performed tests, and the team said on social media that he is not in immediate danger.

Obraniak is from Poland and is currently playing for Caykur Rizespor on loan from the German team Werder Bremen. Fenerbahce won the match 5-1, with Moussa Sow scoring one of the goals.

Three people were taken to the hospital as a precaution after a vintage sports car and a 4WD crashed into each other head-on. The accident happened on Easter Sunday night at a traffic light intersection on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney.

The sports car was a 1973 E-Type Jaguar, which is believed to be worth more than $120,000. It was completely destroyed when it hit a Toyota Kluger. Although no one was injured, all three adults were taken to the hospital just to be safe. NSW police are still investigating how the crash happened.

People in Shandong Province, in eastern China, are carrying natural gas in plastic bags. Recent photos show residents from Lijin village in Dongying city using rickshaws to transport bags of gas that can be up to six meters long, according to People’s Daily Online. People who saw this were worried because the gas is explosive. They compared it to carrying a bomb, noting that even a small flame or a cigarette could cause a disaster. This practice is common in some villages in Shandong. Local media say villagers do this to save money on transportation costs.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which has made people hopeful that he will play in this year’s Masters. This is the first Major tournament of the year. Woods has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5, when he quit the Farmers Insurance Open because his back pain came back. He has taken time off to try to get back to his best form. Many people think he will return for the Masters, a tournament he has won four times. Woods was seen practicing at Augusta on Tuesday, and reports say he has gone back to the course. He has fallen out of the top 100 in the world rankings for the first time in nearly 19 years.

The BBC is facing criticism for spending thousands of pounds of public money on a 44-page guide that teaches staff how to use emojis correctly. BBC executives hired an agency to research how smiley faces could be used in news stories and on social media. They also paid designers to create graphics of popular stars, like Gary Lineker and Graham Norton, as emojis. This spending happened before the BBC used a "sad face" emoji to report the death of the world’s oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top long-distance runner and frequent training partner of Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. This is because he reported to Ugandan authorities that a coach was sexually abusing female runners, some as young as 15.

Kipsiro, who won the 10,000m gold medal at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last year, told Sportsmail that five female runners came to him for help. After he reported these allegations to the police and his national sports federation, he received death threats.

Patrick Kluivert, a former player and assistant coach for the Netherlands, has started his job as the coach of Curacao with a win. His team moved on to the next round of World Cup qualifying for 2018 late Tuesday.

Curacao tied 2-2 in the second game against Montserrat. This result meant they won 4-3 overall. They had already won the first game 2-1 in Willemstad on Saturday.

Kluivert helped Curacao reach this next stage of the 2018 World Cup qualifiers. He previously worked as an assistant with Louis van Gaal at the 2014 World Cup.

An 18-year-old student named Brady Eaves was expelled from his fraternity, removed from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation after a video showed him biting the head off a live hamster. DailyMail.com reported last weekend that Eaves, who was privately educated and the stepson of a former candidate for governor in Mississippi, laughed while killing the animal during a drunken Spring Break party in Florida. He could face felony animal cruelty charges, which could result in up to five years in jail and a $5,000 fine.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, asked Kumar Sangakkara to stay in limited-overs cricket for one more year. Sangakkara had announced his retirement from one-day cricket on March 18. Dissanayake made this request after naming a new temporary group to manage the sport, led by former Test cricketer Sidath Wettimuny.

An 18-year-old student named Silhan Ozcelik appeared in court. She is accused of planning to travel abroad to join Kurdish rebels who are fighting against the Islamic State.

Ozcelik went missing from her family’s home in north London last October when she was 17. The court heard that she traveled on the Eurostar train with another man to Stuttgart, Germany. This is where the youth group of the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) has its headquarters.

She is accused of preparing to carry out a terrorist attack in October 2014.

Esteban Cambiasso, a midfielder for Leicester City, has won football’s biggest awards before. However, he says that keeping his current team from being relegated (dropped to a lower league) would be one of the best moments of his career.

Cambiasso used to play for Inter Milan, where he won five league titles and the Champions League in 2010. He also played for the Argentina national team.

He told the BBC that avoiding relegation feels like winning another trophy. He joined Leicester last summer with a one-year contract and did not cost the club any transfer fee.

Crystal Palace manager Alan Pardew says Manchester City can still win the Premier League title, even if they are behind Chelsea. He points out that City has come back from behind before. Last season, they passed Liverpool with only one game left to win the championship. In 2012, Sergio Aguero scored a last-minute goal in the final match to beat Manchester United.

Right now, Chelsea is six points ahead of City, but City has one game left to play. Pardew, whose team plays against City on Monday, believes the competition is not finished. He has made it clear that he does not think City is out of the race for the title.

Arsene Wenger has not yet decided if he will give Abou Diaby a new contract, but he suggested that the injury-prone midfielder might stay at Arsenal after this summer. Diaby returned to play in a practice game on Wednesday, but he has only played 22 times in the last five years because of long periods of injury. Arsenal plays Liverpool on Saturday afternoon. Wenger probably will not put Diaby in this important match, but he did say that Diaby could get a new contract, possibly one where he is paid based on how much he plays.

Even without Tiger Woods or Rory McIlroy, the Shell Houston Open in Humble, Texas, is doing very well. Record numbers of people have come to watch the tournament, which is the last event before the Masters. The event has been a huge success thanks to the popular play of Phil Mickelson and local favorite Jordan Spieth.

Eighteen months ago, Spieth was criticized for quitting college to join the PGA Tour when he was ranked only 809th in the world. Now, at just 21 years old, he has risen to number four in the world. Interestingly, no one is criticizing him anymore.
